outcome: composite neonatal adverse outcome (macrosomia, Apgar score at 5 min less than 7, preterm birth, need for neonatal intensive care)
cohort: 80 pregnant women (40 with GDM and 40 normoglycemic controls) aged 18-40 years, between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation, with no known chronic disease.
finding: Maternal serum gelsolin levels were significantly lower in pregnant women with GDM and showed potential as a biomarker for GDM diagnosis, as well as an association with composite neonatal adverse outcomes.
